title: Vercel Pricing: Hobby, Pro, and Enterprise plans

facts.fact: Vercel's Hobby plan costs $0 per month.
facts.quote:
Hobby

$0/mo.

The perfect starting place for your web app or personal project.

facts.fact: Vercel's Pro plan is listed at $20 per month.
facts.quote:
Pro

Popular

$20/mo.

Everything you need to build and scale your app.

facts.fact: Vercel's Pro plan includes $20 of usage credit.
Vercel's Enterprise plan is priced on a custom basis rather than a listed rate.
facts.quote:
Enterprise

Custom

Critical security, performance, observability, platform SLAs, and support.

facts.fact: Vercel's Enterprise plan includes a 99.99% SLA.
Vercel's Pro plan includes free viewer seats for team collaboration.
Vercel's Pro plan includes 2 microfrontends projects, and each additional project costs $250.
facts.quote:
2 included projects

2 included projects

then $250 per additional project

facts.fact: Vercel states that all listed prices are in USD and exclude VAT, GST, and other applicable taxes, which are added to the invoice where required by law.
facts.quote: All prices shown are in USD and exclude value-added tax (VAT), goods and services tax (GST), and other applicable taxes.

facts.fact: Vercel's Firewall Rate Limit starts at $0.50 per 1M allowed requests after 1M included requests per month.
facts.quote:
1M allowed requests / month included

Starting at $0.50 per 1M allowed requests

facts.fact: Vercel's Blob Storage Size is priced at $0.023 per GB after 1 GB per month is included.
facts.quote:
Blob Storage Size

1 GB / month included

$0.023 per GB

facts.fact: Vercel's ISR Reads start at $0.40 per 1M after 1M reads per month are included.
facts.quote:
ISR Reads

1M / month included

Starting at $0.40 per 1M

facts.fact: Vercel's Bulk Redirects cost $50 per month per 25K redirects, with 1K included per project.
facts.quote:
Bulk Redirects

1K included per project

$50 / month per 25K redirects

facts.fact: Vercel Functions Fluid Active CPU includes 4 hours per month and starts at $0.128 per hour beyond that.
facts.quote:
Fluid Active CPU

4 hours / month included

Starting at $0.128 per hour

facts.fact: Vercel Functions Fluid Provisioned Memory includes 360 GB-hrs per month and starts at $0.0106 per GB-hr.
facts.quote:
Fluid Provisioned Memory

360 GB-hrs / month included

Starting at $0.0106 per GB-hr

facts.fact: Vercel Function Invocations include 1M per month and start at $0.60 per 1M beyond that.
facts.quote:
Function Invocations

1M / month included

Starting at $0.60 per 1M

facts.fact: Vercel Image Optimization Transformations include 5K per month and start at $0.05 per 1K beyond that.
facts.quote:
Image Optimization Transformation

5K / month included

Starting at $0.05 per 1K

facts.fact: Vercel Fast Origin Transfer includes 10 GB per month and starts at $0.06 per GB beyond that.
facts.quote:
10 GB / month included

Starting at $0.06 per GB

facts.fact: Vercel's Spend Management lets users set a limit and receive alerts, with usage stopped before the budget is exceeded.
facts.quote: Set a limit, get alerts, and we'll stop usage before you go over budget.

facts.fact: Vercel's Fluid Compute is billed only for actual execution time rather than idle resources.
facts.quote: Only pay for actual execution time, not idle resources.
